parameters.name: Region
parameters.description:
The region where the task is started. Valid values:

*   ap-southeast-1: Singapore
*   ap-southeast-5: Indonesia (Jakarta)
*   cn-beijing: China (Beijing)
*   cn-shanghai: China (Shanghai)

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-live-pull-to-push --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --task-id fd245384-4067-4f91-9d75-9666a6bc0000 --biz-region cn-shanghai --region cn-hangzhou
